notes: The 'no' of 'hath no delight' is the negative's recast determiner (rule 15), and the light verb 'hath' stays with the verb whose complement 'delight' is (rule 44).
כִּי אִם → 'But only' is one rendering of the pair: neither morpheme owns 'only' by the subtraction test, so rule 30 fuses and rule 23 heads on the governing first morpheme.
